description: kovan-discovery's CommitInfo carries only 'summary' (first line). Trailer parsing needs the FULL message body, plus the author-date ISO string. Extend CommitInfo with a body field (and author date) in kovan-discovery rather than writing a second git layer -- update its doc comments and any existing call sites. Then implement parse_trailer: locate the '^API-Usage-Since-Last-Commit:\s*(.+)$' line (MULTILINE) and split the remainder on whitespace into key=value pairs. Unit-test against real commit bodies from this repo, including commits with no trailer and with source=none.
title: kovan-metrics: commit body + trailer parsing

description:
s22 and s23. Before asking anything, attempt automatically: fingerprint/duplicate detection, title/authors/year, DOI, embedded metadata, existing BibTeX match, native-text availability. Then ask ONLY meaningful classification: SOURCE (open/redistributable vs restricted/proprietary), TOPICS, PROJECTS, with inline + New Topic / + New Project.

Ingestion transaction order (s23): fingerprint -> duplicate check -> store PDF under open/restricted storage -> create/update BibTeX -> create paper directory -> create paper kovan.toml -> create research markdown -> establish classifications -> update derived index/graph -> open Research workspace.

SAFE DEFAULT IS RESTRICTED where redistribution permission is unknown -- 'free to download' is not redistributable (s41, and this workspace's own DATA_POLICY.md rule that unsure means proprietary). After ingestion Kovan must NEVER normally ask for project root, markdown path, output path, operator, or OCR model. Existing kovan-literature ingestion (pdf_import.rs, metadata.rs 1922 lines) is the starting point; note op-nv6g (visibility wrongly defaults to Open for staging imports) and op-szai (unreliable metadata extraction) are open defects in that path.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: src/ingest.rs (preview/ingest over kovan_literature::extract_metadata/to_bibtex/parse_bib_entries/render_entries -- reused, not re-solved) + the classification form in wiki.rs's IngestFlow. preview() runs s22's automatic half (title/authors/year/DOI via extract_metadata, citekey suggestion + collision check) without writing; ingest() runs s23's transaction (store PDF under open/restricted per explicit SOURCE choice, append bibliography.bib atomically, create paper dir + kovan.toml + markdown stub, refresh the index cache). SAFE DEFAULT IS RESTRICTED: IngestFlow::new defaults access to Access::Restricted, and ingest() never reads KovanDocument::visibility (which extract_metadata infers from the source file's existing path -- meaningless for a freshly picked file, the documented cause of op-nv6g). No topics/projects chosen falls back to Classification::unsorted() rather than blocking. Scope note, stated in the module doc: duplicate detection is citekey-collision only for this pass, not a full content-fingerprint database -- that's real follow-up work, not done here. 3 tests (preview+ingest happy path, citekey-collision rejection, unsorted fallback), using a synthetic lopdf-built PDF fixture. cargo test --release -p kovan --lib: 294 passed, 0 failed.

title: kovan redesign 09: PDF ingestion into the root (+ Ingest Literature)

description: Maintainer report on GitHub issue #30 (comment posted 2026-08-22T03:42:59Z, right after the op-zfnh/op-8ixa/etc progress report): 'digitiser doesn't really autocalculate the points for me using the max and min x and y. I want the points to be calculated.' Root cause: the four axis-reference lines (op-zfnh's persistent draggable box) are seeded with pixel positions on image load, but their VALUES (ref_val[0..4], what those pixel positions mean in data units) start as empty strings. calibration() correctly rejects empty/non-numeric values, but auto_trace()'s failure path just sets self.message to a one-line string at the very bottom of a long scrollable side panel -- easy to miss entirely, especially with no visual distinction from the normal status line. Net effect: user drags the box, clicks Auto-trace, nothing visibly happens, no points appear. Fix: make calibration completeness/validity visible BEFORE the user even clicks Auto-trace (inline per-field validation) and make a failure message impossible to miss (prominent banner, not a buried label).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Fixed: added DigitiseApp::message_is_error (set via new set_status/set_error helpers, replacing every raw self.message = assignment) plus (1) a prominent red banner duplicating any error message at the TOP of the side panel, right under the heading -- not just the easily-missed one-line status label at the bottom of a long scrollable panel; (2) live inline per-reference-value-field validation (green check / orange 'not set' / red 'not a number') so an incomplete calibration is visible before Auto-trace is even clicked; (3) auto_trace() now distinguishes 'traced 0 points' (shown as an actionable error suggesting threshold/curve-colour/box-placement) from a genuine pipeline error, instead of silently reporting '0 points' as if it were a normal success. Verified: cargo check clean both targets, cargo test --release -p kovan clean (160+15+17+7 passing).

title: kovan-gui: digitiser Auto-trace fails silently when reference values are unset/invalid
